partnership_announcements.description: Algen Biotechnologies announced a multi-target partnership with AstraZeneca to use its AlgenBrain AI/CRISPR platform to discover novel immunology targets. AstraZeneca gains exclusive rights to develop and commercialize therapies for selected targets, and Algen may receive up to $555 million in upfront and milestone payments.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Algen Biotechnologies is researching methods and systems for identifying target genes and determining drug effectiveness by generating latent space representations of nucleic acid data to map phenotypic cell states and therapeutic targeting regions. They also develop improved methods and compositions for CRISPR interference and activation to modulate gene function. Together, these efforts focus on gene network decoding, drug response mapping, and functional genome engineering.

product.name: AlgenCRISPR Gene-Modulation System
